title: Application Engineer
description:
**Application Engineer – Hydraulics

Location: C

oimbatore

**Department:**
Application / Engineering

**Experience:**
4–8 years of relevant experience

**Education:**
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering. Diploma/Bachelor’s degree with specialization in Hydraulics is preferred. Hydraulic certification is an added advantage.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an
**Application Engineer – Hydraulics**
who can understand customer applications and technical requirements and develop suitable hydraulic solutions.

The role involves
**hydraulic system and circuit development, component selection and sizing, technical calculations and troubleshooting**
, along with coordination with the Sales, Design, Factory and Service teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand customer applications and technical requirements.
* Develop suitable hydraulic systems and circuits based on the application.
* Select and size appropriate hydraulic components.
* Work with hydraulic components such as gear, piston and vane pumps, hydraulic motors, directional and proportional valves, pressure and flow-control valves and cylinders.
* Work with hydraulic attachments, rotators and power packs.
* Read and understand hydraulic circuit diagrams.
* Carry out basic load, torque and pressure calculations required for hydraulic applications.
* Troubleshoot hydraulic system and application-related issues.
* Provide technical inputs for customized and project-related requirements.
* Coordinate with Sales, Design, Factory and Service teams for technical requirements and execution.
* Provide technical support during assembly, installation or commissioning when required.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics background.
* Strong understanding of hydraulic systems and components.
* Good knowledge of hydraulic pumps, motors, valves and cylinders.
* Ability to read and develop hydraulic circuit diagrams.
* Good understanding of component selection and sizing.
* Ability to perform basic load, pressure and torque calculations.
* Good troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.
* Ability to understand customer applications and convert them into suitable technical solutions.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic knowledge of electrical controls / PLCs is an advantage.
* Willingness to learn and work with different hydraulic applications.

**Technical Skills**

* Hydraulic system design
* Hydraulic circuit development
* Hydraulic troubleshooting
* Component selection and sizing
* Gear / piston / vane pumps
* Hydraulic motors
* Directional & proportional valves
* Pressure & flow-control valves
* Hydraulic cylinders
* Rotators and hydraulic attachments
* Hydraulic power packs
* Load, torque and pressure calculations
* Hydraulic circuit reading
* Basic electrical controls / PLC knowledge

**Training

Product and role-related training/knowledge transfer will be provided as required.

Work Pattern**

* Work will involve coordination with the
  **Sales, Design, Factory and Service teams**
  .
* Customer interaction may be required to understand technical/application requirements.

The role may involve supporting customized and project-related hydraulic requirements.**

title: Contractual Copyediting Reviewer – Physical Sciences
description:
**Job Description:**

We’re currently looking for
**Copyediting Reviewers**
on a work-from-home basis. This would be a contractual agreement, and renewable upon mutual consent. Work will be available regularly so that you can maintain a predictable schedule.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Review manuscripts copy-edited by other editors to ensure that the edit meets the journal's language and style requirements:

a. Critically assess the quality of edits performed by other editors to confirm alignment with journal expectations. Provide constructive feedback, flag inconsistencies or errors, and perform corrective edits where required to meet quality benchmarks.

b. Perform in-depth language editing to ensure manuscripts are written in clear, concise, and grammatically correct scientific English, while maintaining the original meaning and scientific accuracy intended by the author.

* Make changes to ensure that the manuscript conforms to the journal's style requirements: Apply journal- or publisher-specific guidelines related to formatting, structure, terminology, and referencing. Ensure uniformity and consistency in style across all manuscript sections, including text, tables, figures, and supplementary material.
* Share feedback with editors to support continuous improvement: Offer constructive, actionable feedback to editors on their work, highlighting strengths and suggesting specific areas for improvement. Engage in knowledge-sharing to help editors refine their skills, align better with journal expectations, and grow professionally.

**Qualifications and Prerequisites**

* A degree (Bachelor's/Master's/PhD) in Physical Sciences or Engineering
* **Experience in copyediting (mandatory)**
* Proficiency in using MS Word, specifically, Track Changes and styling options.
* Familiarity with the AMA style guide (preferred)

**Benefits of this Role**

* Flexibility. You can work from anywhere in the mentioned countries.
* You will have unlimited access to exclusive interviews with industry experts, articles on the latest industry trends, and publication and writing tips on our internal discussion platform.
* You will be exposed to research carried out worldwide and will get an insider’s view of the burgeoning, multi-million-dollar publishing industry.

**About CACTUS**

Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

* Support vendor surveillance and sub-supplier quality control activities.

* Strong knowledge of ASME Sec III.
* Good understanding of inspection and testing requirements for castings, forgings, machined parts, fabricated parts, and assembled pumps.

description:
**Job Description: Product Development Engineer – GD&T & Tolerance Analysis**

**Experience:**
5–10 Years

**Industry:**
Medical Devices / MedTech

**Location**
: Coimbatore

**About the company:**

**NovintiX**
is a fast-growing engineering and digital transformation company serving top Life Sciences, MedTech, and Healthcare clients across the US, Ireland, and Europe. We specialised in delivering high-impact digital programs, engineering services, and talent solutions that accelerate innovation, efficiency, and compliance.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Product Development Engineer with strong expertise in GD&T and Tolerance Analysis within the Medical Device / MedTech industry. The candidate will be responsible for supporting product design and development activities, developing and reviewing mechanical engineering drawings, performing tolerance stack-up analysis, and ensuring product functionality, dimensional accuracy, reliability and manufacturability. The role involves working closely with cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from design concept and development to verification, validation and manufacturing transfer.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support mechanical product design and development activities for medical device components, assemblies and products.
* Develop, review and interpret engineering drawings using GD&T principles in accordance with ASME Y14.5 standards.
* Perform 1D and 3D tolerance stack-up analysis to evaluate dimensional variations and ensure proper product fit, form and function.
* Define and validate dimensional tolerances, datum structures, geometric controls, fits and clearances.
* Evaluate design concepts for functionality, manufacturability, assembly requirements and dimensional performance.
* Collaborate with Design, Manufacturing, Quality and Supplier Engineering teams to resolve design and dimensional challenges.
* Review supplier drawings, CMM reports and dimensional inspection results to ensure compliance with engineering specifications.
* Support design reviews, engineering changes, design verification and validation activities.
* Perform root cause analysis and support corrective actions for design-related and dimensional nonconformances.
* Apply DFM and DFA principles to improve product design, manufacturing efficiency and assembly processes.
* Maintain engineering drawings, design documentation and technical records in accordance with applicable medical device quality requirements.

**Preferred Skills**

* 5–10 years of experience in Product Development, Mechanical Design or Product Design Engineering within the Medical Device / MedTech industry.
* Strong hands-on experience in GD&T and ASME Y14.5 standards.
* Experience performing 1D and 3D tolerance stack-up analysis for mechanical components and assemblies.
* Proficiency in engineering drawing interpretation, dimensional tolerancing, datum schemes and geometric controls.
* Experience with CAD tools such as Creo, SolidWorks or Siemens NX.
* Exposure to tolerance analysis tools such as CETOL or 3DCS.
* Knowledge of mechanical design, precision components, material selection and manufacturing processes.
* Experience with CMM, dimensional inspection and measurement techniques.
* Understanding of ISO 13485, DFM, DFA and medical device product development lifecycle.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Amazon Growth Engineer
description:
**About the role**

This is a graduate program for engineers with AI/ML, data or systems skills. We will train you on Amazon, then hand you the full growth engine for million-dollar brands on Amazon India and the US.

You do not need any Amazon or e-commerce experience. We need front-runners who think in data and systems, and look for evidence before they act, and we will teach you the marketplace.

Most Amazon roles split listings, ads and inventory across three people who rarely talk. This role joins them. You will plan the sales number, build the listings and ads that deliver it, make sure stock is there to sell, and explain every gap between plan and actual.

You will work inside ProfitStory's in-house AI platform (Moneyball), with a Postgres data warehouse and agentic tools for advertising and seller analytics. ProfitStory manages around $60M in client GMV and is part of NVIDIA Inception. Your engineering skills are the advantage here: you will build the models, automations and guardrails that let you manage brands at a scale no manual team can match.

**What you'll own**

We cross-train you across seven areas, one at a time. Within your first year you own all seven for your brands, with one outcome: the brand hits its sales plan profitably, with no surprises.

**1. Listings - SEO and AEO**

* Write and optimise titles, bullets, descriptions, A+ content and backend keywords using AI tools, grounded in Brand Analytics and search query data.
* Optimise for answer engines too (AEO): Amazon Rufus, and AI shopping answers on ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google. Structure content so these engines can find, understand and recommend the product.
* Track indexing, keyword rank and conversion rate after every change.

**2. Inventory planning**

* Build replenishment plans in SQL and AI tools: sell-through, days of cover, lead times, MOQ and FBA capacity limits.
* Plan inbound shipments to avoid stock-outs and excess or aged inventory, ahead of sales events.

**3. PPC - plan and execute**

* Build and run Sponsored Products, Brands and Display campaigns end to end: structure, keywords, bids, budgets and negatives.
* Manage ACoS, TACoS and ROAS targets set against the brand's profit goals, not just spend.

**4. Evidence, guardrails and validation**

* Set the rules every change must pass before it goes live: bid and budget caps, price floors, listing edits, reorder quantities.
* Validate every AI recommendation before it is executed: it must cite the data behind it, and that evidence must hold up when you check it. After execution, measure the outcome against what was expected. Catch anomalies in spend, price, Buy Box and stock early.

**5. Automation**

* Turn repeated work into scripts, SQL jobs, alerts and AI agents: reports, bid rules, stock alerts, listing checks.
* Document each automation so the team can run and trust it.

**6. Forecasting and the sales plan**

* Forecast monthly sales by ASIN from history, seasonality, events (Prime Day, Great Indian Festival, BFCM) and planned ad spend.
* Turn the forecast into a plan the brand signs off: revenue, units, ad spend and inventory needed.

**7. Deviation analysis**

* Every week, compare actual against plan and find the cause: traffic, conversion, price, ad spend, stock-outs, Buy Box loss or competitors.
* Present the fix and the revised plan to the client in clear, simple language.

**What you bring**

The critical skill is analytics. You find patterns, correlations and causes in data, and you separate signal from noise. When AI recommends an action, you check its citations, test it against the evidence, decide if it is safe to execute, and measure the result afterwards.

* B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in any branch, 2027 final-year students, with a strong foundation in one of:

-
**AI/ML:**
Model building, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG or agents.

-
**Data:**
SQL, statistics, data analysis, time-series or forecasting.

-
**Systems:**
Python, APIs, automation, backend or data pipelines.

* Working SQL and Python. You can query a dataset and explain what it says.
* Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or similar) in projects or daily work. Show us what you built.
* A project, internship or GitHub repo that shows how you solve problems with data or code.
* Curiosity about business: how products are sold, priced and found by customers.
* Clear communication in English. You can explain a number to a non-technical person.
* Willingness to learn fast, take ownership, and work extra hours during peak sales events.

No Amazon or e-commerce experience needed. We teach that.

**Nice to have**

* Kaggle, hackathon or competition work in ML, forecasting or analytics.
* Experience with any REST API, or with building an AI agent or chatbot.
* Familiarity with Excel or Google Sheets for quick analysis.
* Exposure to BI tools such as Metabase, Looker Studio or Power BI.
* Your own experience selling online, on any platform.

**Why join**

* Use your AI and data skills on real money from day one: million-dollar brands on Amazon India and the US.
* Learn a rare mix: engineering plus marketplace business, which few graduates have.
* Work with new-age AI tools every day, and build your own on our platform.
* Grow with a team in NVIDIA Inception, building the future of marketplace growth.

**Details**

* **Eligibility:**
  B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech / Msc / MCA, any branch (2027 final-year students only)
* **Location:**
  Coimbatore, on-site
* **Type:**
  Internship, with conversion to a full-time role based on performance.
* **Compensation:**
  Based on market standards, performance in interviews and strength of candidate

title: Junior Engineer, Process
description:
Junior Engineer, Process Gradiant India Private Limited Coimbatore, India 10/12/26 Engineering
  
  
Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
  
  
Discover us at www.gradiant.com.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced senior Engineer with a strong background in the water industry to join our Global Engineering Center team to execute International and Local projects in India. The ideal candidate will have 8 -10 years of relevant experience, with a preference for those who have worked in an EPC environment, international project experience and possess a deep understanding of water treatment processes. The role requires exceptional process Engineering and process control skills, including the ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and coordination with Project Management team effectively.
  
  
**Specific Duties/Responsibilities**

* Responsible for process and process control engineering.
* Develop detailed process engineering deliverables after contract award.
* Closely working proposal / Application team to receive the as sold documents, technical clarifications, specification package, process design documents, etc. and continue developing preliminary proposal documents.
* Developing process and process control documents like Basis of Design, Process datasheet for RFQ, Process Flow Diagram, Mass Balance Calculation, Hydraulic Profile, Equipment Sizing Calculations, P&IDs, Cause & Effect Matrix, Process control, Control narrative / philosophy, Alarm list, Utility List, Chemical calculations / consumption list, and Operation & Maintenance Manual – Process.

* Participate in the technical evaluation process for vendor selection.
* Review documents from other disciplines and Vendors to make sure process requirements are met in all aspects.
* Participate in HAZOP/HAZID/FMEA and process design review meetings with Customers.
* Work with Vendors and finalize package Vendor P&IDs and other process documents.
* Work Closely with Application / NPI (New Product Introduction) / R&D team to make sure Technology requirements are implemented to meet process guarantees.
* Review 3D model process perspective.
* Involve commissioning team as when needed.
* Attend PLC FAT for process controls.
* Prepare Commissioning and SAT procedure.
* Responsible for document submission schedule to meet project delivery on time.
* Responsible for design change log (internal and external changes).
* Assist commissioning team to prepare commissioning procedure and Site Acceptance Procedure.
* Commissioning and warranty claim support.
* Maintain good communication with all stakeholders and provide visibility on direction and results.
* Stay up to date with the latest technologies, trends, and regulations related to water and wastewater treatment processes.
* Evaluate current treatment processes and identify areas for improvement.
* Ensure safety, health, and environmental compliance for all activities under their control.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering is desirable.
* 1-3 years of experience in process and application engineering in the water and wastewater industry is required for this position.
* Familiar with various water and wastewater technologies.
* Understanding of membranes and membrane processes for water treatment.
* Excellent analytical thinking, teamwork, interpersonal/communication skills, writing and problem-solving capabilities.
* Applicants must be willing to travel as and when required.
* Proficiency in computer skills like MS Office software, AutoCAD, and 3D model Navisworks.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment and interact with all levels of management.
* Ability to travel as required for project needs.
* Experience working in a multicultural environment and in an international business.
* Excellent customer orientation, willingness to deal with people, be flexible and be able to meet customer demands.
* Shares suggestions to improve quality & productivity.
* Familiarity with various water treatment methods, technologies, and equipment.
* Knowledge of the design and engineering principles specific to water treatment facilities.
* Knowledge of the legal and regulatory framework related to water treatment, environmental standards.

30%

title: Senior Onboarding & Implementation Specialist
description:

**Work Shift: US Working Hours — Mandatory**

**Experience: 4-6 years**

**About RunLoyal**

Do you care about the businesses that care for pets every day — and want to build software that helps them operate better?

Do you enjoy breaking complex systems, finding problems before customers do, and building automation that makes engineering teams faster and more confident?

If your answer is yes, RunLoyal could be the place for you.
  

RunLoyal is a fast-growing vertical SaaS technology company building modern software for the pet care industry. Boarding facilities, daycare centers, groomers, trainers and dog parks use our platform to run their businesses and give pet parents a better experience. We headquartered in Atlanta, GA.

An all-in-one platform: business management, a custom branded app for every customer, staff tools, payments, communications, reporting and Scout AI. Pets make it approachable. The software is the craft.

Our platform powers the day-to-day operations of pet-care businesses across boarding, daycare, grooming, training, memberships, payments, customer engagement, reporting, and facility operations.

As RunLoyal continues to scale its platform, customer base, and engineering organization, we are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who wants more than a traditional development role.

This is an opportunity to work on a real SaaS product, solve meaningful customer and engineering problems, and take ownership of features from idea to production.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and other teams to understand the problem behind a requirement, contribute to technical decisions, build scalable solutions, validate them thoroughly, and support what you ship.

If you enjoy working in a growing product company where engineers are expected to think, build, improve, and own, this role is for you.

**What You'll Own**
**Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Become the customer's primary implementation contact after the Sales handoff.
* Lead structured discovery sessions with business owners and operational stakeholders.
* Understand customer workflows, services, pricing, memberships, packages, staffing, booking rules, payments, agreements, notifications, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Identify unclear, conflicting, or incomplete requirements before implementation begins.
* Translate business needs into the correct RunLoyal configuration.
* Recommend practical workflows and explain product limitations or alternatives when required.
* Escalate genuine product gaps to Product or Engineering with clear business context.

**Product Configuration & Data Migration**

* Configure customer environments based on approved requirements.
* Set up services, pricing, memberships, packages, staff access, booking workflows, policies, payments, and related settings.
* Work with customer data from Excel, Google Sheets, CSV files, and structured exports.
* Clean, normalize, transform, and map data into required import formats.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, malformed, or inconsistent records.
* Validate imported customer, pet, membership, package, service, and other operational data.
* Complete post-import reconciliation and escalate discrepancies before go-live.

**Implementation QA, Training & Go-Live**

* Validate configured environments against approved customer requirements.
* Test realistic workflows covering booking, pricing, payments, memberships, staff access, services, and customer records.
* Identify configuration or data issues before they reach the customer.
* Conduct administrator and staff training.
* Explain workflows clearly to technical and non-technical users.
* Confirm readiness across configuration, data, users, payments, training, and operational processes.
* Drive customers through go-live and provide support during the initial launch period.
* Complete a structured handoff to Customer Success or Support after stabilization.

**Technical Troubleshooting**

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable investigating before escalating.

You will:

* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues independently.
* Use browser developer tools where helpful.
* Use SQL for data verification and investigation.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, data problems, integration behavior, product defects, and enhancement requests.
* Provide Engineering and QA with clear and reproducible issue details.

**Senior-Level Ownership**

* Manage complex, multi-location, or high-value implementations.
* Handle multiple onboarding projects concurrently.
* Identify implementation risks early and create mitigation plans.
* Act as an escalation point for complex onboarding issues.
* Review configuration and migration work completed by junior team members.
* Coach team members on discovery, data quality, solution mapping, and customer communication.
* Help improve RunLoyal's implementation standards, templates, documentation, and processes.

**What We're Looking For**
**Experience**

* **4–6 years of relevant professional experience**

  in SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, implementation consulting, solution consulting, business analysis, technical account management, or a related customer-facing role.
* At least
  **2–3 years of direct ownership of US based B2B SaaS implementations or similarly complex customer projects**

  .
* Independently managing customer onboarding via phone, customer training, and demos is a non-negotiable.
* Experience leading customers from discovery through configuration, migration, training, and go-live.
* Experience working directly with business owners, operational leaders, or senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.

**Core Requirements**

* Strong customer discovery and requirements-gathering skills.
* Ability to translate business workflows into software configuration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong implementation QA mindset.
* Advanced working knowledge of
  **Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets**

  .
* Experience with CSV-based data cleaning, mapping, transformation, and validation.
* Strong written and verbal English communication.
* Confidence leading customer meetings independently.
* Strong organizational and project-management skills.
* Ability to identify risks, manage dependencies, and communicate blockers clearly.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
* Comfortable working
  **mandatory US business hours from Coimbatore**

  .
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business, Computer Applications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills**

The ideal candidate should have working knowledge of:

* Excel / Google Sheets
* CSV data handling and transformation
* SQL fundamentals
* Webhooks and integrations
* SaaS configuration concepts
* Browser-based troubleshooting
* Data validation and reconciliation
* CRM and project-management tools

You are not expected to code production software, but you should be technically confident enough to investigate problems before escalating them.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* US based B2B or vertical SaaS implementation.
* Multi-location or operational software.
* Customer data migrations.
* SQL-based validation or troubleshooting.
* API-based integrations.
* Payments or transactional systems.
* HubSpot, Jira, Asana, Notion, Monday.com, Intercom, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
* Mentoring junior implementation or onboarding specialists.
* Startup or scale-up environments.
* Pet-care, hospitality, scheduling, POS, healthcare, field-service, or appointment-based businesses.

You do not need experience with every tool listed above. Strong ownership, learning ability, customer judgment, and SaaS implementation experience matter most.

**Good to have**

* REST APIs
* JSON
* Relational database concepts
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, integrations, and webhooks at a functional level.

**What We'll Evaluate**

We will assess your ability to:

* Discover how a customer's business actually operates.
* Translate requirements into the right SaaS configuration.
* Own implementations from Sales handoff through go-live.
* Work carefully with customer data and prevent avoidable migration errors.
* Lead customer conversations and manage expectations professionally.
* Investigate technical issues before escalating.
* Manage multiple projects without losing track of decisions, risks, deadlines, or dependencies.
* Demonstrate senior-level judgment and ownership.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will be measured through:

1. **Time to Go-Live**

   — Customers launched within agreed timelines.
2. **Implementation Accuracy**

   — Low configuration and migration errors after launch.
3. **Customer Onboarding CSAT**

   — Satisfaction with communication, implementation, and training.
4. **Go-Live Readiness**

   — Successful completion of configuration, migration, validation, and training.
5. **Early Customer Adoption**

   — Customers actively using agreed RunLoyal workflows after launch.

Additional measures may include migration accuracy, escalation quality, documentation completeness, handoff quality, and implementation backlog.

**Why Join RunLoyal?**

* Own customer implementations from kickoff through successful launch.
* Work directly with US business owners and operational leaders.
* Build expertise across a complex SaaS platform spanning scheduling, payments, memberships, customer operations, reporting, and integrations.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Support.
* Help shape RunLoyal's implementation processes as the company grows.
* Build a career toward roles such as Implementation Lead, Solutions Consultant, Solutions Architect, Implementation Manager, Technical Account Management, or Customer Success Leadership.

**Our Values**

**Kindness**

**Trust**

**Fearlessness**

**Discourse, Not Dissonance**

**Understanding, Not Consensus**

**Ownership**

**Curiosity**

**Ready to Own the Customer Journey?**

If you enjoy
**understanding businesses, solving complex problems, working directly with customers, managing meaningful SaaS implementations, and growing with a fast-moving product company**

, we would love to hear from you.

And yes—a genuine love for pets is always a plus. 🐾

**RF Bench Test Engineer Wireless & RF Semiconductor Validation**

* Location: Coimbatore, Bengaluru, India
* Work Mode: Onsite
* Experience: 3 -10 Years

Role Overview

We are looking for an RF Bench Test Engineer with experience in RF semiconductor validation, characterization, and laboratory testing. The role involves developing RF bench validation setups, performing first silicon bring-up, executing RF characterization, and supporting engineering validation for wireless semiconductor products. The engineer will work closely with cross-functional teams to validate RF performance, debug hardware issues, and automate validation workflows.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, integrate, and debug RF bench validation setups for wireless semiconductor devices.
* Perform first silicon bring-up, engineering validation, functional verification, and RF characterization.
* Design and validate RF evaluation boards, interface boards, shield boxes, switch matrices, and custom validation fixtures.
* Execute RF transmitter (TX) and receiver (RX) performance measurements including Output Power, Gain, EVM, ACPR, Receiver Sensitivity, Blocking, BER, Phase Noise, and Harmonics.
* Validate RF technologies including Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, GPS/GNSS, NFC, UWB, Zigbee, LoRa, and Cellular (4G/5G).
* Perform antenna characterization, RF front-end validation, impedance matching verification, and S-Parameter measurements.

**Job Description**
**Reuse Engineering**
**Location :-**
Bangalore/ Coimbatore/Pune

3-6 years
  
  
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a place where you’ll be empowered to shape your career, supported by a collaborative global community, and inspired to reimagine what’s possible. Join us in helping leading Consumer Products and Retail Services (CPRS) organizations unlock the value of technology and drive scalable, sustainable growth.
  
  
**Introduction**
The D&E Re-use team is responsible for the re-use of parts from Excess and Obsolete stocks to reduce costs, eliminate waste. Drive the transformation of D&E towards design for Re-use to unlock the potential of circular use of materials.
  
  
**Job Description - Grade Specific**
**Job Mission**
This competence is about the design and development of electrical cabinets and associated connectivity interfaces. The electrical cabinets contain diverse sets of electrical equipment like controllers, power supplies, computing modules etc. Activities comprise designing connectivity: cabling harnesses between active and passive electronic boards (PCBA's), electric transducers (sensors and actuators), racks, cabling and connections (plates and feedthroughs), and engineering the cabinet/enclosure.
  
  
As an Electrical Mechanical Engineer, you will be involved in electrical and mechanical 3D design, cabling and routing design, creating product documentation (TPD) and participation in product validation and test. You will be part of a team with Project managers and Lead engineers.
  
  
****Job Description****

* In this position, you will lead investigations on re-use potential on E&O (Excess & Obsolete)stock, identify re-use opportunity and represent D&E in X sector team.
* Discover and investigate the parts re-use opportunities from various influx channels
* Identify re-use opportunities and create an Reuse analysis report.
* Perform Technical part of reuse analysis, including AsNew autonomously using information from ASML system and expertise generated within reuse department, with minimum contact with FC’s
* Engineer is expected to do extended design activities related to Reuse, but no real design work.
* Support other departments to realize the reuse activity.
* Work with other ASML colleagues around the world(ASML sites) to implement reuse projects
* Share the experience and knowledge that you learn from reuse process

**Education**
Bachelor or Master in Electro-Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
****Experience****
You have 3 – 6 years of experience as engineer of electronic functions, including
  
  
experience with working in multidisciplinary module design teams to establish agreement on specifications.
  
  
****Personal Skills****

* Ability to initiate and drive/contribute to reuse projects, identify process gaps and work towards improvements
* Demonstrated responsibility for the results in his competence or process
* Be able to use mature skills and technical concepts to find the best solution to a specific problem in an innovative and creative way.
* Have good communication skills with cross departments to perform reuse activities
* Generate and maintain procedures.
* SAP, Teamcenter and NX experience
* Ability to read manufacturing drawings, BOM and Technical process documentations
* Hybrid working environment

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

title: Engineer – Mechanical Design
description:
* Assistant Design Engineer with expertise in mechanical equipment design & development, will play a pivotal role in design & development of water treatment plants – STP process & equipment design and collaborating with operations team for site installations. The role is expected to create innovative and efficient solutions that meet project requirements and environmental standards by analyzing and optimizing mechanical systems.
* System Design:

Executing the complete product design and development (Concept development & finalization, design calculation for tank sizes, defining process parameters - Aeration time, settling time, HRT, SRT, volume of air required, Tank Overflow calculation; Pipe sizing and discharge estimation using hand calculation or software, Sizing the filtration system & dosing requirements).
  
  
**Equipment Selection**
Select appropriate mechanical equipment and components based on project requirements and performance requirements. Evaluate and choose pumps, blowers, mixers, agitators, compressors and other mechanical devices suitable for water & waste water treatment applications.
  
  
**Process Optimization**
Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement strategies to enhance process efficiency of the plant.
  
  
**Documentation**
Create detailed engineering drawings, specifications and documentation of the mechanical systems. 3D modelling of concept design, equipment design calculation, layout plan, testing, validation and drafting for Water Treatment Plant. Preparation of BOQ for costing.
  
  
**Operations Collaboration**
Shall provide support for procurement, installation and commissioning, collaborating with electrical, civil and environmental engineers to ensure seamless integration of mechanical systems with other plant components.
  
  

* BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with 3 to 5 years of experiences in water treatment industry for Product & Process design.
* Should possess strong understanding of the principles of waste water treatment processes and their application.
* Previous experience in design of water treatment plant, skid piping, structures including layout, knowledge of specifications for various pumping/lifting, filtration and disinfection systems will be an advantage
* Exposure to design, development and operations of STP/ETP/RO/UF is preferred.
* Familiarity to treatment plant’s automation such as SCADA, IIOT, Sensor technology and knowledge of prevailing discharge standards as per Local, State, and National guidelines. Exposure to design of air ventilations systems.
* Hands on experience in SolidWorks & AutoCAD. Exposure to SolidWorks pipe routing will be an added advantage.

title: Electrical and Instrumentation Engineer
description:
Responsible for Electrical and Instrumentation engineering activities for Air-Cooled Heat Exchanger (ACHE) packages in accordance with project specifications and client requirements.

Prepare, review, and coordinate technical documents for electrical equipment, including motors, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), Local Control Stations (LCSs), Junction Boxes (JBs), and vibration monitoring devices.

Review and prepare equipment datasheets, General Arrangement Drawings (GADs), Single-Line Diagrams (SLDs), wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.

Coordinate with vendors and suppliers for technical offers, datasheets, drawings, compliance statements, and technical clarifications.

Prepare and maintain electrical load lists, cable schedules, equipment lists, and technical document submission trackers.

Review vendor documents and ensure compliance with project specifications, applicable IEC/IEEE standards, and client engineering requirements.

Coordinate Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs), Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) procedures, and inspection-related documents.

Coordinate with clients, consultants, and vendors to resolve technical queries, review comments, and engineering discrepancies.

Monitor document submission, review, approval, and revision status to ensure timely completion of project deliverables.

Coordinate and support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), routine testing, functional checks, and electrical control circuit string testing.

Review hazardous-area equipment requirements and verify applicable IECEx, ATEX, and PESO certifications as specified in project documents.

Coordinate technical interfaces between motors, VFDs, LCSs, instrumentation devices, and control systems, including Modbus TCP/IP communication requirements.

Review and resolve client comments on engineering documents and coordinate the incorporation of revisions for resubmission and approval.

Coordinate with procurement and project teams to ensure technical requirements are addressed during equipment ordering, inspection, and delivery.

Maintain project engineering records, vendor documentation, inspection reports, and technical correspondence.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Consulting – Banking & Capital Markets: Finacle Core Banking**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile: Business Analyst – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a functional and techno-functional Business Analyst with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking. The role focuses on requirements management, solution mapping, process modelling, data analysis, integration and API requirements, interface specifications, and banking data structures across Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role Business Analyst – Finacle Core Banking**
**Experience 5+ years in banking; 3+ years in business analysis**
**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Business Analyst in banking transformation projects.
* Conduct requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions with business and technology teams.
* Gather, analyze, document and validate business, functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents and test scenarios.
* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Business Analysis or banking domain certification such as CBAP, CCBA or ECBA.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Our Commitment
  
  
**As a commitment,**
we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Engineer - Instrumentation & Automation
description:
Engineer - Instrumentation & Automation Gradiant India Private Limited Coimbatore, India 8/19/26 Engineering
  
  
Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide.
  
  
Discover us at gradiant.com.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Instrumentation and Automation Engineer with less than 6 years of experience to join our Global Engineering Centre team to execute International and Local projects in India. The ideal candidate will have less than 6 years of relevant experience, with a preference for those who have worked in an EPC environment, international project experience.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Prepare and issue Instrument schedule / Index, Instrument I/O list, Instrument Cable Schedule, Cable Block Diagram, JB Interconnection Drawing, Junction Box schedule, Instrument Hookup Drawings and Bulk Material take off.
* Preparing Instrument data sheets for Control valves, On-off valves, PSVs, and other field instruments like Analyzers, Level, Flow, Temperature and Pressure Transmitters and Gauges.
* Familiar in all Flow Instruments like Orifice, Magnetic, Paddle, Ultrasonic, Turbine and Vortex Flow meters.
* To have experience in complete procurement Engineering cycle of field Instruments with Datasheet preparation, RFQ, Technical Query, TBE and Vendor Document Review.
* To have experience on reviewing Mechanical packages with Static and Rotating equipments.
* Review of P&ID's, Cause & Effect Matrix, Control Philosophy.
* Review of all 2D Drawings and 3D Model with navis.
* Interdisciplinary Checking with Process, Mechanical, Piping and Civil/Structural.
* Collaborate with Technical project manager to plan and execute projects on time and on budgeted manhours
* Participate in project meetings, design reviews, and progress assessments to ensure project objectives are met.
* Quality Control and Compliance: Ensure that all Instrumentation designs and installations comply with applicable codes, standards, and industry best practices. Conduct quality control reviews to verify design integrity and safety.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor / Master Degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, Instrumentation Engineering
* Water Projects, Chemical Processing, Power Plant projects, Pharmaceuticals, Food Industry and/or Oil & Gas Projects experience is preferred.
* Knowledge in WTP/STP/WWTP/ETP/UPW projects added advantage.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO**
**)**
Gradiant is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Workday HCM Technical Analyst
description:
Are you a Workday expert who enjoys solving complex business challenges, designing
  
  
innovative solutions, and making a real impact on the employee experience? We're
  
  
looking for a highly skilled
**Workday HCM Technical Analyst**
to serve as a key
  
  
technology partner to our Human Resources organization.
  
  
In this role, you'll be the go-to expert for Workday, driving the configuration,
  
  
optimization, integration, and continuous improvement of our HR technology ecosystem.
  
  
You'll work across multiple Workday modules, collaborate with business and technical
  
  
teams, and help transform HR processes through automation, analytics, and innovative
  
  
solutions. No two days are the same. One day you may be architecting a complex
  
  
integration, the next designing executive dashboards, implementing new functionality, or
  
  
solving business challenges through creative system configuration.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining deep technical
  
  
expertise with strategic thinking. If you're passionate about Workday, thrive in a fast-
  
  
paced environment, and enjoy partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful
  
  
business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**What You'll Love About This Role**

* Be a trusted Workday expert and technical advisor for HR.
* Influence the design and evolution of our HR technology landscape.
* Work with a broad range of Workday modules, integrations, security, reporting, and analytics.
* Interfaces and security will be your expertise area.
* Participate in challenging projects, enhancements, and new capabilities from concept through implementation.
* Partner with HR, IT, Payroll, Benefits, and vendors to deliver solutions that improve business processes and employee experience.
* Continuously learn and stay up to date on the latest Workday functionality, implementation trends and best practices.

**Core Capabilities**

* System Configuration: Experience deploying integrations for Workday HCM modules, including Core HCM, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, and Benefits, to align with business requirements.
* Data Management: Manage data integrity and accuracy within the Workday system, including data imports, exports, and reporting. Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with data standards.
* Integration Expert: Collaborate with IT and third-party vendors to design, implement, and maintain integrations between Workday and other systems (e.g., payroll, time tracking, IAM, and benefits administration).
* User Support: Provide technical support and training to HR staff and end-users, addressing system-related inquiries and troubleshooting issues as they arise.
* Reporting and Analytics Expert: Develop and maintain custom reports and dashboards in Workday to provide insights into HR metrics and support data-driven decision-making.
* Project Participation: Participate in Workday upgrade projects, enhancements, and new module implementations, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to best practices.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, processes, and user guides to facilitate knowledge sharing and training.
* Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal security policies, monitoring access and permissions within the Workday system.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience as a Workday HCM Technical Analyst or in a similar role, with a strong understanding of Workday HCM modules, functionalities, interfaces, security, configurations and reporting.
* Proficiency in Workday reporting tools, including calculated fields, custom reports, and dashboards.
* Proficiency with Workday Integrations using XML, XSLT, SOAP, REST API, and Configurable Security/experience securing web services.
* Experience with Workday integrations (e.g., PICOF, PECI, WECI, EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio) is required.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights.
* Strong design and architecture skills to generate and maintain specification documents and integration documentation.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Workday HCM and Workday Integration certifications is a plus.

**Who We Are**
Mold-Masters (www.moldmasters.com) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.
  
  
Hillenbrand (www.hillenbrand.com) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.

title: BIM Coordinator
description:
**Company Description**
Mepography is a global BIM and Digital Engineering company delivering high-performance MEP, Architectural, Structural, and Construction Engineering solutions for complex projects worldwide. The organization specializes in services such as MEP BIM Modeling, Revit Engineering, Clash Detection, Shop Drawings, Scan to BIM, Point Cloud Modeling, and advanced LOD and 4D/5D BIM solutions across multiple sectors including residential, commercial, industrial, healthcare, infrastructure, power plants, airports, and mission-critical facilities. Mepography supports contractors, consultants, developers, and EPC organizations with technically accurate and execution-focused BIM workflows that enhance coordination, reduce project risks, accelerate delivery timelines, and improve construction efficiency. Operating across India, Singapore, the Middle East, Europe, and the United States, the company is committed to world-class digital engineering standards, innovation-driven project execution, and long-term value creation for the global AEC industry.
  
**Role Description**
The BIM Coordinator is a full-time on-site role based in Coimbatore, responsible for managing and coordinating BIM workflows across multidisciplinary project teams. This role includes setting up and maintaining BIM models, enforcing project standards, and ensuring model accuracy and consistency for MEP, architectural, structural, and construction deliverables. The BIM Coordinator will facilitate clash detection and issue resolution, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, and support the production of shop drawings and other project documentation. Daily activities also involve working closely with engineers and designers to optimize model efficiency, preparing progress reports, and contributing to continuous improvement of BIM processes and tools.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong BIM coordination skills, including experience with Revit, Navisworks, and other industry-standard BIM tools.
* Candidates should possess capabilities in model management and quality control, including clash detection, model auditing, and adherence to BIM standards and protocols.
* Candidates should possess practical knowledge of MEP, architectural, and structural systems, with the ability to interpret drawings, specifications, and construction documentation.
* Candidates should possess skills in project collaboration and communication, including coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, managing stakeholder inputs, and documenting issues and resolutions.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to identify and mitigate design and coordination risks.
* Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or related engineering / architecture fields, or proven experience in BIM coordination within the AEC industry.
* Experience with LOD development, 4D/5D BIM, and large-scale or international projects will be considered an added advantage.

Make A Difference (MAD) is one of India’s largest millennial-driven non-profit organizations focused on transforming outcomes for children in need of care and protection. Guided by a vision that children growing up in care can achieve equitable outcomes on par with the middle class, MAD works with young people from age 10 to 28 using holistic, long-term, and age-transitional developmental approaches. The organization currently partners with around 60 shelters across 23 cities, supporting approximately 3,500 children through a largely volunteer-driven model of about 4,000 team members operating on a flat, distributed, and virtual infrastructure. title: Bench Digital & Mixed-Signal Validation Engineer
description:
Bench Digital & Mixed-Signal Validation Engineer

* Location: Coimbatore, Bengaluru, India
* Work Mode: Onsite
* Experience: 3- 10 Years

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Bench Digital & Mixed-Signal Validation Engineer to support silicon validation, characterization, and board-level verification for semiconductor products. The role involves first silicon bring-up, bench validation, hardware debugging, interface validation, and laboratory automation using industry-standard test equipment. The engineer will work closely with Design, Product Engineering, Embedded Software, PCB Design, and Manufacturing teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, integrate, and debug bench validation setups for Digital and Mixed-Signal semiconductor devices.
* Perform first silicon bring-up, board bring-up, engineering validation, and silicon characterization.
* Design and validate evaluation boards, interface boards, adapter boards, interposers, and custom validation fixtures.
* Review schematics and PCB layouts while performing power sequencing and board-level debugging.
* Validate communication interfaces including I C, SPI, UART, GPIO, USB, PCIe, Ethernet, DDR, SD/eMMC, MIPI, CAN, LIN, and JTAG.
* Develop automated validation frameworks for instrument control, data acquisition, regression testing, and report generation.
* Execute electrical validation, functional validation, stress testing, interoperability testing, and regression testing.
* Analyze waveforms, timing diagrams, protocol transactions, and register-level behavior using laboratory instruments.
* Debug hardware, firmware, software, silicon, and system-level issues through structured root cause analysis.
* Develop validation procedures, test plans, characterization reports, and engineering documentation.
* Support Engineering Validation (EV), New Product Introduction (NPI), Product Qualification, Reliability, and Customer Validation activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Design, Firmware, Embedded Software, Product Engineering, Manufacturing, and Customer Support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering (EIE), Instrumentation Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, VLSI Design, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* 3 -10 years of experience in semiconductor bench validation, silicon characterization, laboratory validation, or product validation engineering.
* Hands-on experience with semiconductor validation hardware and laboratory instrumentation.
* Strong understanding of digital electronics, mixed-signal systems, board-level debugging, and validation methodologies.

**Technical Skills**
**Bench Validation & Silicon Bring-Up**

* Bench Validation
* First Silicon Bring-Up
* Board Bring-Up
* Silicon Characterization
* Engineering Validation (EV)
* Product Qualification
* Functional Validation

**Hardware Validation**

* Evaluation Boards

* Resolve complex incidents associated with firm\-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand\-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences.

* Advanced analytical skills are required to address end\-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk\-up issues.

* Experience in leading projects and overseeing contribution and performance of project members
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience is desirable.


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, organizational, project and time management skills.
* Excellent customer service attitude.
* Demonstrated multitasking abilities in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel.
* Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers.
* Approximately 4\-8 years of extensive experience in end user software and hardware and technology support


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Engineer – Continuous Improvement
description:
* The Senior Engineer of TBS will act as a primary catalyst for operational excellence, specifically supporting lean initiatives across our transactional processes. This role is critical in championing the standard design and global deployment of the Texmo Business System (TBS), ensuring that TBS frameworks are seamlessly integrated into the organization's daily operations and quality management standards.
* Kaizen \& Transactional Process Improvement (TPI):
+ Support strategic planning, facilitation, and execution of transactional process improvement (TPI) Kaizen events.
+ Monitor post\-event progress, proactively identifying and escalating deviations to ensure sustained results.
+ Mentor and handhold cross\-functional Kaizen teams, coaching them effectively on TBS tools and techniques.
+ Support organizational problem solving using A3 methodology.
+ Enhance daily management and problem solving at transactional processes.


**TBS Governance \& Global Deployment**
* Drive and support the standardized deployment of the Texmo Business System across global locations.
* Maintain TBS standards and processes as per the defined structure and place accessible easily and update on regular intervals.


**TBS\-QMS Integration**
* Bridge the gap between continuous improvement and quality assurance by accurately translating TBS documents and processes into Quality Management System (QMS) language.
* Upkeep the document master and ensure rigorous version control across all platforms.


* Qualifications \& Expertise:


**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Engineering.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 A minimum of 7 to 10 years of progressive experience focused on continuous improvement, TPI processes, and QMS.
   

  

**Technical Proficiencies**
* Expert\-level knowledge of Lean methodologies and project management lifecycles.
* Strong proficiency in advanced process mapping techniques, specifically Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and Makigami.
* Practical, hands\-on experience utilizing statistical analysis software such as Minitab and JMP.
* High proficiency in data visualization and reporting tools including MS Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Exceptional facilitative and influencing skills, with a proven ability to lead and drive change within a matrixed, cross\-functional environment.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Superior communication and presentation skills, demonstrating the ability to distill and convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
